name: Health Benefits for Pregnant Mothers and Newborns through Supraja-AYUSH
benefit: - Health benefits are provided to pregnant mothers and newborns through Ayurvedic treatment. - Medicines are dispensed as per the individual’s medical condition. - An OPD fee of ₹10/- per person is charged for availing the services.
_eligibility_text: 1. The beneficiary must be a pregnant woman or a newborn belonging to Uttarakhand.
